scripts.cli: npm run build -w packages/tools -w packages/engine -w packages/plugin-browser && node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/index.tsx
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/tools -w packages/engine -w packages/plugin-browser
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w packages/tools -w packages/engine -w packages/plugin-browser -w apps/cli
scripts.build:site: node packages/plugin-browser/scripts/package-extension.mjs && mkdir -p site/downloads && cp packages/plugin-browser/dist/marshall-browser-extension.zip site/downloads/ && cp install.sh site/install.sh
scripts.release: npm test && npm run build:all && changeset publish
